title: Germany says Russia behind Leipzig airport drone attack
hook: Germany says Russia behind Leipzig airport drone attack

beats.caption: Germany says Russia behind Leipzig airport drone attack
Why was a drone found at a major airport?
beats.narration: Why was a drone carrying an explosive device discovered at a major airport in Germany?

beats.caption: It happened right near Ukrainian cargo planes.
beats.narration: The device was found on August 4th, parked suspiciously close to Ukrainian cargo planes.

beats.caption: German officials are now blaming Russia.
beats.narration: German authorities have concluded that Russia was behind this specific attack attempt.

beats.caption: This wasn't a guess, it was verified.
beats.narration: This assessment has been verified across five independent news organizations.

beats.caption: This is part of a wider pattern.
beats.narration: It highlights growing security concerns regarding sabotage attempts across European infrastructure.

beats.caption: Authorities are taking this very seriously.
beats.narration: Officials are treating the event as a serious act of state-sponsored aggression.
